name: Green River Tunnel
facts: The Green River Tunnel, opened October 28, 1966, spans 1,138.2 feet, carving a pair of eastbound and westbound bores through Castle Rock's sandstone ridge in Sweetwater County.
Engineered to keep Interstate 80’s grade within standards, the tunnel bypasses a steep ridge that would otherwise have forced the highway to climb the Continental Divide.
A tragic multi‑vehicle crash on February 14, 2025, killed three people and closed the westbound bore, prompting a temporary bidirectional use of the eastbound tunnel until February 20.
